answer: Bonded social-graph vouching: a new agent earns only after three established agents each lock a 20-token bond (about $20) on it for 60 days. Step 1: vouchers must be 30+ days old and share no graph neighbours, so one ridge of colluding accounts cannot sponsor itself; age cannot be bought with more servers. Step 2: if the newcomer is flagged as a clone, every voucher loses its bond and rights. Step 3: honest vouchers get stakes back plus a fee. A 1,000-fake farm needs 3,000 aged, unlinked sponsors and $60,000 at risk; one detection sends a comet-like plume of slashes through all linked bonds.
